route.instructions: Which single route should handle this utterance?

criteria.get_time: Ask for the current local clock time
criteria.get_weather: Ask for current weather, including for a stated location
criteria.add_reminder: Create one reminder with stated note text, such as 'remind me to study'
criteria.set_thermostat: Set the thermostat to one explicit Celsius temperature
criteria.control_lights: Turn lights on or off, set one light color, or set light brightness
criteria.set_timer: Start one countdown with an explicit duration
criteria.set_alarm: Set one alarm with an explicit clock time and AM or PM
criteria.playback_control: Pause, stop, resume, skip, or change volume of current music
criteria.play_music: Start playing music using a stated genre, mood, artist, or title
criteria.small_talk: A brief greeting, thanks, or simple conversational reply that needs no tool
criteria.other: Complex or multiple actions, forecasts, ambiguous follow-ups, factual questions, messaging, or calls
